crossRefs.note: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
“That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go…
and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation…
To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who…

parallels.note: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

translations.web: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’
translations.bsb: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
translations.kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
translations.asv: Go ye therefore unto the partings of the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage feast.
